notes.title: Call to Arms out NOW!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6466393/2ac70d21696e4a5c923b277217c2968ef91b2e7b.jpg[/img]

[h1]Call to Arms version 1.0 available now![/h1]
Wohoo! We made it! Call to Arms is finally live on Steam :cta_emo7:

We hope you will enjoy all the new content that is available to you. 

With a team of less than 25 people, we are very grateful for the support and help we received from our community and we want to give you a big thank you for making Call to Arms possible! This is really a great accomplishment we want to build on in the future.

If you encounter any issues, or have feedback for us, please let us know. We will be continuously improving the game, even after the release.

A successful launch will enable us to make this game better and better, so please share the news with everyone. Thank you!



[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6466393/529bff867658fa1fdbb0e504675669680d0498d8.jpg[/img]
The game means a lot to us. It has been an integral part of our lives for the last couple of years and we invested more into it, than we probably should have, but we didn’t just want to deliver yet another game, but a game full of passion and exciting potential. Even if the game is not perfect and has room to improvement, we think that we can be proud of what has been accomplished so far and we hope you will enjoy it, as much as we enjoyed working on it!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6466393/2989b33f85ccb141f6318cf02bc0f8a49b8a8eed.jpg[/img]
We apologize for creating a lot of confusion with the monetization of the game. At any point, treating our loyal customer base fairly has been our top priority. However, we obviously have failed in communicating this well enough. During the time we have been working on Call to Arms, we have seen studios rise and fall, we have seen Early Access games pop up and never deliver what has been promised. We decided that it is extremely important to learn from these mistakes and don’t fail on delivering our promises as well. We also wanted to lay out a roadmap for people to see and understand what will come for Call to Arms after release, so that they can make an educated purchase decision and choose whether to support us further or not. Of course, we understand that it is upsetting, if we talk about DLC content without even finishing the game first, but we believe, that it is even worse to keep players in the dark.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6466393/275aa2bf39a1dd9e387b5b77ce91321d34a50c8c.jpg[/img]
The free version is a great way for people to have a look into the game, before purchasing it. Something that has been rather common in times of demos and open betas. It helped greatly to keep the game alive, which has been extremely difficult with so much competition around. When we first started selling games on Steam, there were at about 250 games per year. That’s what Steam has almost per week now and it’s still rising. Understandably, it has been increasingly difficult for players to make educated purchase decisions and that’s why we had to adjust to this new situation. Of course, we must find a good balance between the free version and value for money of the full version, but we certainly are getting there.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6466393/105d400b55d13c0690bf946a58f1a45234e3f21e.jpg[/img]
In this regard, please understand that the game is very important to us. People’s jobs and futures depend on it. Therefore, if you can, please take the time to read exactly what we wrote and don’t assume the worst. If you still can’t figure out what was happening, we are happy to help anytime. It is part of our business mentality to always hand out more content, than we promise, as we strongly believe, overpromising and underdelivering is a very poor business practice that we don’t want to be associated with. It’s a needle to our heart, if people claim that we have cheated or lied, as honesty and fairness is a core reason to run this company independently. Our principles are not for sale, even if that means, we must close our doors. Therefore, we hope, we can rebuild trust and prove to you, that you have chosen to support the right indie developer.

The game has been in Early Access for 2 ½ years. That’s a lot longer than we planned to keep it there. However, we haven’t been turning our thumbs in the meantime and to prove that, we have collected the most important changes for you and did some comparison shots with the first public version of Call to Arms!


[h1]Core engine upgrades[/h1]
When we first started off with the game, the custom engine we use has been upgraded from DirectX9 to DirectX11, which was a huge improvement in enhancing the graphics and performance. Many probably didn’t know that the engine was singlethreaded, that means, it only used one core of your CPU, instead of all. We fixed this and added multithreading support. Lately, we upgraded the game from 32bit to 64bit. Something that is fundamentally important for us and modders, as it ends the out of memory issues (granted you have enough memory). This way we can support way more factions and units at the same time. Unfortunately, 64-bit has caused some side-effects with the current netcode, which we are still trying to fix entirely. These changes have been very difficult, as the engine and game are not separated from each other, this means, that we may improve and fix something and break many parts of the game at the same time. Hence, it takes plenty of time to do it right. The most important changes have been listed below.
[code]
•	Unicode localization support (more than 1 language at the same time) 
•	New font rendering system
•	Faster archive loading speed
•	Improved debugging tools to lower crash frequencies
•	Options presets for easy graphics set-up
•	Steam controller support
•	Windows API instead of DirectInput
•	XML support for interface
•	New main menu
•	New in-game HUD
•	Replays
•	Texmod multiplayer support for infantry and vehicles
•	Snow pather simulation
•	Scaleable LODing, zNear, FoV 
•	New sound engine with near/far sound support 
•	Enhanced environment sound support
•	Inside vehicle sound filters
•	Improved netcode
•	Improved overall game launch performance
[/code]
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6466393/733fc3acb49b7a5d1b381b254b841f28b2fc5a4f.jpg]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6466393/df1ed4fcc0c76038a26e641398e731db46b6bf6f.jpg[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6466393/dbd8592f11e0825b04825cfa3c56ea52323edd78.jpg]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6466393/aba24a59b7f5622b4abafb5326cdaf18c239a906.jpg[/img][/url]
--
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6466393/e1bfc684ca26a7aaf9cc849dd0fe214ebe85ce97.jpg]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6466393/9d7a3875fe185da0b4a6b23a5368fae18801832e.jpg[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6466393/6b0b92196a6215fb1eac085382bc134a5d2c7e38.jpg]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6466393/a0aa89430e3bcb76db509618a12e964a2e5c89b4.jpg[/img][/url]


[h1]Graphic Engine upgrades[/h1]
We believe that the comparison shots say more than any words, but it doesn’t harm to list the specific improvements we have done to the graphic engine to enhance the overall visuals of the game. It has been a lot more work, than it may look like at first, because unlike engines like UE4 and Unity, our custom engine didn’t provide any support for these visual effects. We had to code them from scratch and upgrade the engine accordingly.
[code]
•	Depth of field
•	Soft particles
•	HDR glow
•	Close camera rendering support (z-near)
•	Specular effect balancing
•	Screen Space Ambient Occlusion
•	Glossiness map support
•	Colored specular map support
•	Enhanced skyboxes for full HD environments
•	Ocean rendering system
•	New water technology with depth support
•	Sun and moon simulation
•	Light scattering effect
•	Dirtlense effect
•	Alpha to coverage
•	New wind shader to simulate different weather conditions
•	1st person HD scope support
•	Blur masks
•	3d shells and magazine drops
•	Translucency shader
•	Friend/Foe outline markers
•	New outline silhouettes 
•	Support for BC5 texture compression for normal maps 
•	Human heads variation support
•	Film grain support (used in specific modes)
•	Vision mode support
•	Color correction
[/code]
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6466393/2df5ae3d110fba2d3347d9eab73aa918f0d4736c.jpg]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6466393/dba68edbc3b523d0f448e6077da78b1f51ff959b.jpg[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6466393/274b090a499469fc778595a8c199bb80a0c53592.jpg]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6466393/2f61e74304ba2f51da3b3beb43dc2da2ccd54538.jpg[/img][/url]
--
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6466393/f9602276555083db792ed1cee57773945762d2b2.jpg]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6466393/8972963f03ff86a1e62202ebcd0112c3da238339.jpg[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6466393/c0a0801ff6c963f9048eeb7e97b642f6d601d304.jpg]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6466393/4ccb0e475912684267c6fcf71f50e89cc3504a9d.jpg[/img][/url]


[h1]Gameplay updates[/h1]
Most important are the gameplay changes of course. The game has changed a lot from the early days and we are happy that we followed our vision on how to further develop the old-school direct control mechanics. While we appreciate the original gameplay, we think it’s great to have a new game where you can choose to play differently. Aside from first and third person controls, we have done many other improvements of course.
[code]
•	Introduced 1st and 3rd person controls for vehicles and soldiers
•	Automatic ammo supply
•	Fortification system
•	Chat wheel support
•	Multiplayer bots
•	Guided missiles
•	Night/Thermal vision
•	Smoke screens
•	Flashbangs
•	New realistic tracer system
•	Morale factor for infantry
•	Medic ability
•	Alliance system to allow multiple factions per team
•	Mechanics ability, only skilled soldiers can repair vehicles
•	Host join limitation options (experience/performance)
•	Random spawnpoints
•	Difficulty balance for vehicle armor
•	3rd person squad control mechanics
•	Hardcore mode for more realistic engagements
•	RTS mode for strategy only players
•	Introduced helicopter controls
•	Claymores react on bullet hit
•	Alliance based tracer colors
•	Different damage for different body parts
•	Weapon damage based on muzzle speed and caliber
•	Blur for non-focus areas of scopes
•	Shooting while walking for AI infantry
•	Close tank hatch and hide commander for tanks 
•	New infantry reloading system with magazine drops
•	Multiple damage states support for buildings 
•	Enhanced bullet simulation 
•	New suspension simulation physics 
•	Bot support for “unusual” gamemodes 
•	Multiplayer training for beginners 
•	Normal and fast drive modes for vehicles in 1st and 3rd person
[/code]
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6466393/013dd4e9a2f721194643f0431e0963dc5c76e5f6.jpg]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6466393/391272d150ff2a5fd43a9a48dd2aadc8d416508a.jpg[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6466393/6d742319213ad4d99f8bff449f9e16356bd1afe4.jpg]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6466393/6dc49435ea04f557159c65a52c0ba78b050a1b62.jpg[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6466393/c2a16f024e201e03fb233d2176c74101601f9ad2.jpg]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6466393/caec83c720d6ef83535a31d411e1cac5624a5db9.jpg[/img][/url]


[h1]Misc and modding support[/h1]
Undeniably, offering modding support is beneficial for both users and developers alike. We are very happy how talented our modding community is and what great ideas they are able to implement in our game. Hopefully, we can intensify our releationship with modders in the future! Check out their creations on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/302670/workshop/]Workshop[/url] page.
[code]
•	Possibility to adjust coop player counts
•	Level down/up polygon tool in editor
•	Auto-minimap generator
•	Added in-game Workshop download and mod apply
•	Increased max camera distances
•	Environment sounds, wind, rain, thunder etc.
•	Re-designed weapon sounds 
•	Re-designed sounds such as explosions, hits, walk sounds etc.
•	weapon library
•	Squad logos for player units
•	Completely reworked human skins, vehicle skins, weapon skins
•	Reworked vegetation
[/code]
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6466393/4e2be0b559e14fb573dcd9e60a7059049c613170.jpg]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6466393/4ab7dd64d7e7dda906f565e76e2ee989fcad6ede.jpg[/img][/url]
What was once a little game that used 4+ GB of storage, turned into a 30 GB RTS/FPS hybrid behemoth. The game started with 2 factions without vehicles to play on a couple of maps and gamemodes. In the meantime, the content has increased significantly and will only continue to increase after release. While stretched over the period of development, it doesn’t seem like that much, but if you put it into contrast, the differences are quite significant.
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6466393/831cb4cadb120d84de222657aa7758d9c89ec559.jpg]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6466393/a5dc543e81dffa38b566fa5cdc467b12cbc0346a.jpg[/img][/url]


[h1]Gamemodes[/h1]
Since the launch of the first version, we have added a multitude of new gamemodes for online and skirmish battles. Below we present the basic rules for each.

[b]Domination[/b] - Capture strategic zones. The team with the most flags receives points, the more flags you have, compared to your opposing team, the more points you get. A gamemode for competitive players.

[b]Last Man Standing[/b] - Defend your Forward Observation Base and capture ammo depots that will give you extra manpower to call in new units. Annihilate your enemy by capturing their FOB.

[b]Combined Arms[/b] - Helicotpers, tanks, armored vehicles and infantry, all combined in large maps for intense battles. Same rules as Domination.

[b]King of the Hill[/b] - Up to 4 teams. The team who controls the strategic zone receives payback on lost manpower. Capture the zone to win against all other teams.

[b]Evacuation[/b] - Defend your evac zone against hostile AI players. This gamemode is designed for coop gameplay. To get additional resources, capture ammo depots.

[b]Armored Combat[/b] - All about tanks and tanks and tanks!

[b]Heroes[/b] - One soldier per player, make the most out of it!

[b]Cooperative[/b] - Play the Singleplayer campaigns together with friends.
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6466393/fd9780bf609866b2c76c24474fab746b3fa6ed8f.jpg]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6466393/1652a37d7e884a69f51d6d239c212965356bb45a.jpg[/img][/url]


[h1]Factions[/h1]
Upon launch, 4 factions will be available if you own the full version of the game. Contrary to previous games, we tried to accomplish factions that vary a lot more in their strategies and unique weaponry.

[b]United States[/b] - Technologically advanced and well trained, the US Army is prepared for every battle. But the quality comes at the cost of quantity.[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6466393/7a8ce72257e1227bc95d51efeaf93becaa323b20.jpg]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6466393/135aa2dacc9404bb18d51d7dc8594bcb10b0fb14.jpg[/img][/url]

[b]GRM[/b] - The GRM collected their equipment by scavenging government supplies and receiving foreign support.[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6466393/6aef5d42cbaf6b62ddeec507980874aafa9a3ee9.jpg]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6466393/3fda1552df7813e464fa5f0c8752bf353c2dff69.jpg[/img][/url]

[b]UAF[/b] - The UAF are Arab government forces and the counterpart to the GRM. During the second singleplayer campaign, you will rise up against the UAF and join the GRM to topple the government.[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6466393/6ad49f01174397bc9fc5d8446ac234fa64ed32cc.jpg]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6466393/1d62cc7c07f6ac7b75fa4d1c1e1ae0b352d16468.jpg[/img][/url]

[b]Rebels[/b] – The Eastern European Rebels are a very interesting faction, as they combine modern Russian and Western equipment with Cold War era weaponry.[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6466393/3d8be9de3bb0a74bb8802c4d24bf26029e6f0ef5.jpg]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6466393/9db903769e2b8eb78606b42160f5fb7586cc1bee.jpg[/img][/url]

This was just a small fraction of what is new in Call to Arms, but it should provide a good overview. Thank you for reading and for your support. Let’s rock this game!

For a complete list of changes, please check out the full [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/302670/discussions/0/541907675756457744/?ctp=3#c154642447922418230]change-log[/url].

notes.title: Release schedule!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6466393/bb1cc3f19fd47419b795e3e87a58301ecbf373dd.jpg[/img]

Finally, we are ready to give you a roadmap for the planned release of Call to Arms!

The game will be officially launched in April 2018. This also includes the Allied Army DLC, which features two new factions and the GRM campaign. The two new factions are the United Arab Forces and the Eastern European Rebels. Both feature unique technology, that may not be up to date, but enhances the game with cold war era equipment and rare vehicles, as well as firearms.

The release version of Call to Arms will feature 64-bit support, shooting while walking for soldiers, localization in EFIGS + Russian + Chinese and of course plenty of fixes and improvements, as well as performance enhancements.

The Russian and German armed forces will be available step by step, after the release, but do not expect us to rush them out, as developing singleplayer campaigns is very time consuming and we want to make them worth your money.

After release, we will dedicate our time to include two new community voted features: 1. Enhanced fortifications for engineers, such as sandbags, tanktraps and similar. 2. New vehicle damage system to generate more accurate results and longer lasting vehicle combat.


[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/302670/Call_to_Arms/][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6466393/354733896e1ad668b771180e70843ce79f0748e3.png[/img][/url][url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/374390/Call_to_Arms__Deluxe_Edition_upgrade/][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6466393/2f49f98ae96650a29ca20c15a47e1888bfc7af92.png[/img][/url][url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/561140/Call_to_Arms__Season_Pass/][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6466393/40800d4f7b05f673530e74c469b100b65b2fa1e8.png[/img][/url]

Another big news is, that the free version will remain available after the official release and will allow you to play the game, as you are used to, including further improvements and enhancements. The free version will be limited to the initial two factions. The basic edition (full version) features all new factions for free, but requires to unlock new units via the progression system, if you do not own the corresponding DLC. The Allied Army DLC is available for free to Deluxe Edition owners, Ultimate Edition owners and kickstarter backers. Ultimate Edition owners receive beta access to new factions too, in case you want to be one of the first to play with the new toys! (usually one month ahead of release)

notes.title: Feature Vote
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6466393/100a28fb7eb3e82e6559ce0dce6535b4f937cce7.jpg[/img]


[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/302670/Call_to_Arms/]Call to Arms[/url] will be "completed" by the end of the year. The game will be feature ready and most bugs should be fixed by then. However, the official release with proper localization and voice overs will happen in early 2018. Launching the game during the sale season, will only swamp it in the masses of releases and discounts. To avoid that, we will wait until the sale season is over and people are back from vacation. This way, it's more likely, that the game will be a success.


Just because we will "finish" the game this year, doesn't mean we will stop supporting it. Quite the contrary. Already early next year, we will start working on some cool new features. But to decide on what we should focus, your help is required.

notes.title: Developers update 29
notes.notes:
[img]http://digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2banner_05.jpg[/img]

Welcome to our twenty-ninth developers update for [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/302670]Call to Arms[/url]! We will use these updates to keep you posted on the progress of the development and features.

Admittedly, you haven’t heard from us in a while. This has a reason though, we were entirely focusing on improving the game and readying it up for release. That being said, we will launch the biggest and last major update in a couple of weeks and after that we will put all our resources in bug fixing and listening to feedback from our community.

So yes, you heard right, the game will leave Early Access in just a few months!


[h1]In-game UI[/h1]
The next update will finally feature the new in-game menu. It’s a much cleaner version of the one you have learned to know for so long. The improved interface only shows you what you currently need to see and helps to reduce clutter on your screen. We are excited to hear you opinion about it, once we released it in the next update!


[h1]Graphics[/h1]
We almost completed the re-work of the in-game graphics to make them fit the demands of the new first-person view. In the same regard we also worked on several ways to optimize the current game performance so that everyone can enjoy it in a much smoother way. This also includes new lag free multiplayer controls.

Of course, you will also get entirely new human skins for US Forces and much more! :cta_emo10:
[url=http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_138b.jpg][img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_138.jpg[/img][/url]


[h1]AI[/h1]
We did several optimizations to the AI to address one of the biggest concerns players have. Especially vehicle pathing has been vastly improved, which is a pretty big game changer!


[h1]First Person[/h1]
First person also got another significant overhaul. Now ironsights come without artificial cursors and ACOG scopes and similar use proper sights instead of just plain crosshairs! Furthermore, we added a friend and foe detection in direct control. After aiming at an enemy unit for a while, you will get a visual confirmation that you are dealing with opposing forces. This feedback is also provided if you get hit by enemies. 
[url=http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_139b.jpg][img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_139.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_140b.jpg][img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_140.jpg[/img][/url]


[h1]New factions[/h1]
After release, you will get access to new factions, these include the UAF (arab government forces), Eastern European Rebels, German Army and Russian Army. Have a look at our new screenshots to get a taste of what you can expect! Can you tell us which tanks you see?
[url=http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_141b.jpg][img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_141.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_142b.jpg][img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_142.jpg[/img][/url]


[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
We have done tons of bugfixes and gameplay improvements. Way too many to list them. Still there are plenty of improvements to be done and we are eager to listen to your experience with the new version soon.

So thank you for your patience, we really think the waiting was worth it and Call to Arms is shaping up very nicely for a release later this year! :cta_emo7:

notes.title: Developers update 28
notes.notes:
[img]http://digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2banner_04.jpg[/img]

Welcome to our twenty-eight developers update for [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/302670]Call to Arms[/url]! We will use these updates to keep you posted on the progress of the development and features.

It will be rather boring when it comes to development status updates in the next couple of months. This is because Call to Arms is in the last phase of development, as we are using all our resources to finish the game up.

The final version of the game will have a few noticeable improvements. It comes with a new in-game UI, localization and voice overs. Of course, we will provide you tons of fixes and gameplay improvements over the coming months as well. Furthermore, you must wait no longer than Q4 2017 for the release. There will be no further release date shifts.

If you are worried about the lack of content, worry no more. We are already progressing very well on the next two factions for Call to Arms. The United Arab Forces and the Eastern European Rebel Forces. These factions will be available after the release of the game. Deluxe Edition owners, as well as Ultimate Edition owners will receive a new campaign, plus beta access to the factions and instant unit unlock.

In the campaign, you will fight as a civilian who gets caught up in a civil war between the UAF and the GRM. At one point, you will join the GRM to fight against the oppressing forces, who only know friend or foe and care little about the civilian population. The Eastern European Rebels on the other side, will take part in the Russian and German campaign.

Can you detect all the new units on the screenshots? ːsteamhappyː

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/302670]Call to Arms[/url] is currently on sale and we released a new update to try out in the beta branch of Steam. [b]It will be set live in a couple of days![/b]

The new update includes a series of great improvements to the game, if you want to try it out already, please opt into beta, in your Steam game properties.


[img]http://store.steampowered.com/gfxproxy/betagfx/apps/302670/extras/gif_helicopter.jpg?t=1496143446&alt_url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/302670/extras/gif_helicopter.jpg?t=1496143447[/img]
Helicopters come with rocket pods and guided missiles, as well as machine guns for transport helicopters, in order to provide ground support during airborne operations. Helicopters can also land automatically now.

[img]http://store.steampowered.com/gfxproxy/betagfx/apps/302670/extras/gif_tank.jpg?t=1496143446&alt_url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/302670/extras/gif_tank.jpg?t=1496143447[/img]
Tons of bugfixes are coming to the game as well, including improved AI target class logic. More aggressive AI in close combat versus first person controlling players. Of course, lots of small errors and issues have been solved too!

[img]http://store.steampowered.com/gfxproxy/betagfx/apps/302670/extras/gif_rts.jpg?t=1496143446&alt_url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/302670/extras/gif_rts.jpg?t=1496143447[/img]
Singleplayer missions and environment assets have been improved drastically as well. More and better stuff is available in your editor, as a first step to totally overhauling the visuals of the game!


[img]http://store.steampowered.com/gfxproxy/betagfx/apps/302670/extras/gif_fps.jpg?t=1496143446&alt_url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/302670/extras/gif_fps.jpg?t=1496143447[/img]
Of course, you will also receive a great amount of improvements to infantry control, including improved visuals and new weapons, as well as human models. Furthermore, you will be able to enjoy 3d shells, weapon blow back animations, laser and iron sights!

It's a great time to pick up the game, so what are you waiting for? Join us now! :cta_emo10:

notes.title: The road ahead!
notes.notes:
[img]http://digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2banner_01.jpg[/img]

It’s time to share our plans for the future of Call to Arms!

At this stage, it’s important to get everything finished up for the release of the game. We think, games are a service, so you can expect long term support for Call to Arms. That means, once the game is officially released, we are [u]not[/u] done with it. But at some point, we need to leave Early Access and provide a game with fully functional and polished core game aspects.
Our plan is to finish the game in Q2 this year. The official release may happen in Q3, as the right timing for a release matters a lot as well. At this point however, the game is already pretty much done and we will focus on polishing all the existing features and visual aspects. Of course, the release version will include localization for many more languages and completely new voice acting.

In the meantime, our team is already working on new content for Call to Arms. The first upgrade will contain two new factions, the United Arab Forces and the Eastern European Rebels. These factions will be available for beta testing to Deluxe and Season Pass owners in multiplayer, shortly after the release of the game. Once the campaign is finished, which we expect to happen soon after, everyone can use these factions with unit progression.

After that we will jump right into finishing up the German and Russian factions, both are making good progress already. We expect the multiplayer aspect to be released for all factions throughout the year. The campaigns will take more time, as they are the most time-consuming part of development. None the less, the second half of the year, will be a content bomb for Call to Arms.

Something that you can expect in the near future, are improved graphics, better controls and animations, bug fixes, more variations of helicopters with different armament and neat gameplay improvements. Furthermore, we will put a lot of effort into fixing and balancing the small quirks of the game.

[url=http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_111b.jpg][img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_111.jpg[/img][/url]
[url=http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_112b.jpg][img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_112.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]Free Version[/h1]
The free version does not exchange or make the full version less valuable. The free version can be considered a light version that exchanges the needs for a demo. Demos never reflect a game properly, as they are not updated in the same manner as games as a service. Furthermore, a demo isn’t worth it, if you cannot play with your friends who already purchased the game. The free edition of Call to Arms allows you to get a very good idea of what you can expect and increases the online popularity. It also diminishes the need for pirated copies, as people who cannot afford the game, can still play it to some extend and buy it later. There is no pay2win and there will never be pay2win in Call to Arms. Everyone who purchased the full version before the launch of the free version paid less money, than what the full version costs now.

[h1]Upgraded Packages[/h1]
Everyone who bought the game, be it full version or deluxe edition, got their packages improved. That means you get more content than initially announced, as you can see in the sheet below. Deluxe Edition includes an additional DLC and everyone receives access to 4 new factions to come for free. Of course, you will also receive free map packs, content upgrades, new features and much more in the coming months.

[img] http://store.steampowered.com/gfxproxy/betagfx/apps/302670/extras/chart_versions.png?t=1481373148&alt_url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/302670/extras/chart_versions.png?t=1480538882[/img]

notes.title: Developers update 24
notes.notes:
[img]http://digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2banner_08.jpg[/img]
Welcome to our twenty-fourth developers update for [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/302670]Call to Arms[/url]! We will use these updates to keep you posted on the progress of the development and features.

We have been silent lately, however, we weren’t turning our thumbs, in fact the game has progressed tremendously over the past few weeks. The reason for our silence is, that we have been moving to a new and larger office. During development of Call to Arms, our team has grown steadily and it was time to do the next step. Needless to say, that we wanted to accomplish this without adding any further delays to the game, so our focus has been on a smooth transition and we are happy to let you know that we succeeded in doing so. :cta_emo1:

So what have we been working on in the meantime?


[h1]Improved 3rd person controls[/h1]
We spent a lot of time on improving the 3rd and 1st person controls in-game. Better animations, better controls, better heightmap interaction for easier and more accurate movement. Currently we are working on squad movement orders via 3rd person and hit direction indicators, as well as a recoil system to make shooting much more of a skilled experience.


[h1]Sounds[/h1]
The sound environment of battles has been completely reworked. Weapons differ if you are shooting in close or far distance, that leads to a much more natural sound environment. This was necessary to make the 3rd and 1st person experience closer to reality and this added a much better overall experience.


[h1]New factions[/h1]
The new factions are also shaping up very well and soon after release of the game, we should be able to deliver you the first content pack with lots of exciting new equipment and units. Can you guess which tanks you can see on the screenshots?

[url=http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_102b.jpg][img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_102.jpg[/img][/url]
[url=http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_103b.jpg][img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_103.jpg[/img][/url]


[h1]Map pack[/h1]
We are also working on a multiplayer map pack, we expect it to be done by the end of next month. Furthermore, the singleplayer campaign is receiving extra work and polish to make it more interesting and challenging to play.


[h1]Helicopters[/h1]
We think, the screenshot is speaking for itself! :cta_emo10:

[url=http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_104b.jpg][img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_104.jpg[/img][/url]

Stay tuned for more updates coming soon.

Have a nice weekend!

notes.title: Developers update 23
notes.notes:
[img]http://digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2banner_10.jpg[/img]
Welcome to our twenty-third developers update for [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/302670]Call to Arms[/url]! We will use these updates to keep you posted on the progress of the development and features.

The development is in full swing and we are progressing very well. We have reached the last quarter of the development and the game release is in sight. We have set up internal milestones in support of the release preparations. This means, we are clearly prioritizing each task to finish the game in a timely manner without making any compromises on the quality we want to achieve.

While the programming team is currently focusing on the 3rd and 1st person mechanics and soon on the new in-game UI. Our team of artists is already working on the new factions to reduce the waiting time after release!

[img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_98.jpg[/img] 
[img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_99.jpg[/img]

For 3rd and 1st person, we are working on a multitude of changes. We just introduced high quality 1st person human hand models and different damage depending on body areas, as a next step we will be working on improving the animations. Further improvements will include weapon blow back effects, breathing mechanics, slow walking in zoom, new scopes, hit direction feedback, commanding squad members in 3rd person and many more features that improve the whole ground battle experience!

[img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_100.jpg[/img] 


Scopes and sights vary on the type of weapon you are using now. If you are controlling a soldier, a decent vignette effect will also highlight the more accurate aiming and slower walk speed.

[img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_101.jpg[/img] 



[h1]Some humble words[/h1]
First of all, we are very grateful for the support we have received over the many months since we started the development of Call to Arms. The feedback has been extremely valuable to us and we are excited to see how the game is finally shaping up and is becoming a new and fun experience for everyone. Unfortunately, we still have this regular amount of reviewers complaining about the free version, microtransactions, Season Pass without playing the game at all, or reading the available information about these issues. Therefore, we would like to address this once and for all: the purchased editions of the game did not turn into a free game. The game is still up for sale. Maybe the time of demos is so far away by now, that some forgot that it’s actually a good thing if you can try a game out before buying.

Are we milking customers? No, we are adjusting ourselves to the reality we all live in. A reality in which the grand majority of developers are struggling with the flood of games on all platforms, with exploding marketing and development costs and with completely oversaturated markets. A reality in which last year almost 1000 people lost their jobs in the German games industry alone, while we were still hiring people and paying our team on time. If we don’t learn to adjust ourselves, then we will be just another name on a very long and sad list of studios. Sometimes this means radical changes, as we have seen with Call to Arms lately. However, these radical changes increased the player counts by 5 times and increased our profits to a level where we can continue to dedicate all of our resources to the game, which ultimately results in a much better game for everyone.

You can be with or against change, but you can only decide between more and better games of that type with a different business model or no further type of these games at all. So, let us work together on making this a success story for many years to come and focus on what is important: a great game!

notes.title: Happy New Year!
notes.notes:
[img]http://digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2banner_08.jpg[/img]

The [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/302670]Call to Arms[/url] team is wishing you a Happy New Year!


There are exciting times ahead for Call to Arms! With the launch of the open beta we are one step closer to release and we prepared an internal release schedule. Most importantly, that means, you will experience how the game is coming together in a much faster pace now.

The most difficult and time consuming features have been implemented, now we will dedicate a lot of time on polishing and bug hunting. But not only that, our art department is already working on tons of new content for you!


Here is a WIP shot of a new infantry weapon. (low poly + normal map) Can you guess which weapon it is?

[img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_88b.jpg[/img]

[img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_89b.jpg[/img]

As you can see, we boosted the quality a lot, now that we have a 1st and 3rd person view for humans. We will also experiment with better reloading and blow back animations. What we definitely want to add, is a blow back effect on your aiming, so that 1st person shooting becomes a more skill intensive experience.

Over the next couple of months, we will dedicate a lot of time to work on all the little details that make the game better and more fun to play.


[img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_90b.jpg[/img]

Since fun means also new content, we are now dedicating our resources on new factions. We just started with the Eastern European and Russian vehicles. While GRM and the Eastern European Rebels use mostly outdated vehicles, the Russian army comes with modernized version and some very neat exclusive equipment. It's important to us that each faction looks and plays differently. The UAF, allied with the US in Call to Arms, is a coalition of Arab states that received some Western equipment. Hence, expect M60s to counter T62 soon! As you can see above, the uniforms of the UAF also orientate towards their Western allies.

Once we are done with the new human skins, we plan to upgrade the US and GRM skins to the same new level of quality.


[url=http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_91b.jpg][img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_91b.jpg[/img][/url]


In the development, the first 3 quarters are the most time consuming and sometimes most frustrating steps during development. But now we are reaching the last quarter, which is worth all the sweat and blood before. Therefore, we are very excited that we finally reached that point and we are working harder towards release than ever. So again, Happy New Year, 2017 will be a hell of an exciting year! :cta_emo7:

http://store.steampowered.com/app/302670

notes.title: Developers update 22
notes.notes:
[img]http://digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2banner_05.jpg[/img]
Welcome to our twenty-second developers update for [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/302670]Call to Arms[/url]! We will use these updates to keep you posted on the progress of the development and features.


[h1]Hardcore Mode[/h1]
We will be introducing a hardcore game setting created for fast and deadly combat. While we wish to design the base game as a good mix between tactics and action, we still understand that a lot of people would also enjoy a more realistic approach to combat. Hardcore mode will deliver what you are looking for and mistakes will be punished mercilessly.


[h1]Hit Zones[/h1]
Furthermore, we will introduce body hit zones for humans, so if you hit a leg or arm, it will do less damage than a body hit and of course headshot. This will add an additional level of skill required to win battles in 3rd person mode against other humans!


[h1]Damage Indicators[/h1]
We introduced some visual feedback to let players know when a soldier is on low health, in the future we will also implement damage indicators that help you to understand where enemy fire is coming from. This will be useful for soldiers and vehicles.

[img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_87b.jpg[/img]


[h1]Improved Aiming[/h1]
The responsiveness of 3rd person human controls have been improved drastically and more changes are to come. You will be able to enjoy the new mechanics in the next update already! Moreover camera controls have been improved and add additional polish to your 3rd person experience.


[h1]Squad Controls[/h1]
In case your soldier dies, the game will auto select the next squad member, so that you are not losing any time to counter your enemy. On long term, we want you to be able to command your squad members to cover. Hopefully we will be able to prototype the feature early next year. It should enhance 3rd person squad controls drastically :cta_emo1:



If you didn't do so yet, contribute your gameplay video to win a Season Pass!
steamcommunity.com/games/302670/announcements/detail/599372911099903657

http://store.steampowered.com/app/302670

notes.title: Developers update 21
notes.notes:
[img]http://digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2banner_01.jpg[/img]
Welcome to our twentyfirst developers update for [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/302670]Call to Arms[/url]! We will use these updates to keep you posted on the progress of the development and features.


Thank you for the successful start of the Open Beta! We were able to collect a lot of feedback and we are already in full swing to improve the game. Aside from bugfixes, we are fully focusing on polishing the game up, as it is time to prepare everything for the release next year.

Today, we are going to talk about the new infantry controls. Firstly, we are improving the interface to make it easier for you to select your desired weapon or item. Secondly, as you can see above, we were working on an improved camera, that even allows you to have some rudimentary first person controls!
[url=http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_85b.jpg][img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_85b.jpg[/img][/url]

Aside from that, it allows you to have some real indoor fights without nasty camera clipping. Furthermore, we introduced a solution for grenade throwing, that makes it a lot easier to aim at your desired target. Flashbangs will blind you in 3rd person as well.
[url=http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_86b.jpg][img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_86b.jpg[/img][/url]

Lastly, each weapon has it's own zoom distance, so ACOG equipped rifles and sniper scopes give you a major advantage on distance!

The infantry controls are shaping up nicely and we are very happy with the quick progress we are making here. Hope you will be too!

The update is due to the end of the week. :cta_emo7:

http://store.steampowered.com/app/302670/?snr=1_5_1100__1100

notes.title: Fact Check
notes.notes:
[img]http://digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2banner_08.jpg[/img]

While most of you are in-game and hopefully enjoying it, as much as we do working on it, quite a few people pulled out the pitchforks and torches, going rampage in the review section.

We read through the reviews to collect feedback and found many ill informed opinions along that way. So let's discuss a few myths.


[h1]A) I got ripped off![/h1]
The game was sold at $19.99 and $29.99 for the Deluxe Edition in the early stages of Early Access, during that time it has been sold as low as 80% off during the anniversary sale. Today the game is at $29.99 and $39.99 respectively. So at any time during Early Access the game has been cheaper than it is now and everyone who supported us early on saved some bucks!


[h1]B) You are selling DLC in Early Access![/h1]
The first sentence of the Season pass description is: "There will be no DLC released during Early Access". So you actually don't get anything in return for your money right now, except our promise to deliver these DLC to you [b]after[/b] the game has been released. In fact, there is no DLC, only the option for people to support the development if they desire. Nobody is forced or has to buy it. This is a completely personal decision and everyone has the right to decide for themselves, if they want to save money by supporting us ahead.


[h1]C) I should be rewarded for supporting you![/h1]
Exactly what we think! That's why Deluxe Edition owners get a free DLC on top of what they purchased. So free stuff for people who supported us. Even more so, we just announced that there will be Allied factions, as well as Germans and Russians to play next year. For free, for everyone, in multiplayer. Because again, we appreciate your support and want to give back!

http://steamcommunity.com/games/302670/announcements/detail/599372277807788511


[h1]D) You are selling in-game items![/h1]
You can get these items for free. In fact, you constantly get free items and as Deluxe Edition owner you even got exclusive items. All for free, just because we love you. You can sell these items and make money off them and buy new items or other games with it, completely up to you. For some people who don't have the time to unlock stuff, we added the option to purchase them right away. Which is cool, because they financially support the game and help us making it better, so that everyone else can enjoy even more free stuff. If you purchased the game, simply launch it up and enjoy your extra content.


[h1]E) I didn't know there is going to be a Season Pass![/h1]
We didn't know that either. As we said many, many times in the past, DLC depends on the success of the game and when we decided that more is to come for Call to Arms, we were letting you know ahead in Developers Updates. Since we understand, that some would have loved to get a good deal too, we added a discount of 20% to the Season Pass. So if you didn't have the opportunity to buy the cheaper Ultimate Edition before, you can save money for the next two weeks as well. We think that's fair.

Furthermore, we are also obliged to provide a Season Pass to crowdfunding backers who paid for any possible DLC to come out. In this regard, we are simply fulfilling our promises we made long before Early Access.


[h1]F) Free2play is unfair![/h1]
The free2play version is not equal to the full version. The full version is still available to purchase and offers you more than the free version. See the info sheet below. Aside from that, everyone benefits from busy multiplayer lobbies and short waiting times for matches. If you want to know what the exact differences between the full version and free2play version are, please read this announcement.

http://steamcommunity.com/games/302670/announcements/detail/663547937787482857

[h1]G) You did not deliver what you promised![/h1]
No we did not. We delivered way more than we promised. Everything that has been promoted on the store page during Early Access is available to everyone who bought the game right now, even though the game is not even officially released yet. It took us longer to develop the game, because we wanted this game to be bigger and better with the help of the community. We are on the best way to achieve this and everyone will be able to enjoy more cool stuff that we will release for free next to paid content.


[h1]H) You didn't update the game for ages and now you want more money![/h1]
To our regret, this complaint comes from people who stopped playing the game altogether and didn't launch the game up for a long time. A review with a few hours in total and zero hours in the last 2 weeks or more, cannot be taken seriously and doesn't provide useful feedback to anyone. This is just venting some hate based on an ill informed opinion.

Contrary to that, we want to deliver a more enjoyable gaming experience to everyone! That is what indie development is about. If you are angry about shaddy business practices and excessive monetization, let big games corporations know, not passionate indie developers who try to provide the best possible game they can.

Check out the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/302670/discussions/0/541907675756457744/?ctp=3#c215439774871699976]Change-Log[/url] to find out what new stuff you got.


[h1]I) The game is P2W![/h1]
This point is really upsetting. We have yet to find out, why this game turned into pay to win by earning yourself some cosmetics. We guess, those who claim it is, have yet to find out themselves.


So here we are, don't fall for the haters, read our announcements and make up your mind after you collected all the facts. If you are still unhappy with the decision after reading all of this, please provide us feedback on how we can improve your experience with the game. In case, you still have questions, we happily answer them and clarify everything up as well. :cta_emo1:

notes.title: Fact Check
notes.notes:
[img]http://digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2banner_08.jpg[/img]

While most of you are in-game and hopefully enjoying it, as much as we do working on it, quite a few people pulled out the pitchforks and torches, going rampage in the review section.

We read through the reviews to collect feedback and found many ill informed opinions along that way. So let's discuss a few myths.


[h1]A) I got ripped off![/h1]
The game was sold at $19.99 and $29.99 for the Deluxe Edition in the early stages of Early Access, during that time it has been sold as low as 80% off during the anniversary sale. Today the game is at $29.99 and $39.99 respectively. So at any time during Early Access the game has been cheaper than it is now and everyone who supported us early on saved some bucks!


[h1]B) You are selling DLC in Early Access![/h1]
The first sentence of the Season pass description is: "There will be no DLC released during Early Access". So you actually don't get anything in return for your money right now, except our promise to deliver these DLC to you [b]after[/b] the game has been released. In fact, there is no DLC, only the option for people to support the development if they desire. Nobody is forced or has to buy it. This is a completely personal decision and everyone has the right to decide for themselves, if they want to save money by supporting us ahead.


[h1]C) I should be rewarded for supporting you![/h1]
Exactly what we think! That's why Deluxe Edition owners get a free DLC on top of what they purchased. So free stuff for people who supported us. Even more so, we just announced that there will be Allied factions, as well as Germans and Russians to play next year. For free, for everyone, in multiplayer. Because again, we appreciate your support and want to give back!

http://steamcommunity.com/games/302670/announcements/detail/599372277807788511


[h1]D) You are selling in-game items![/h1]
You can get these items for free. In fact, you constantly get free items and as Deluxe Edition owner you even got exclusive items. All for free, just because we love you. You can sell these items and make money off them and buy new items or other games with it, completely up to you. For some people who don't have the time to unlock stuff, we added the option to purchase them right away. Which is cool, because they financially support the game and help us making it better, so that everyone else can enjoy even more free stuff. If you purchased the game, simply launch it up and enjoy your extra content.


[h1]E) I didn't know there is going to be a Season Pass![/h1]
We didn't know that either. As we said many, many times in the past, DLC depends on the success of the game and when we decided that more is to come for Call to Arms, we were letting you know ahead in Developers Updates. Since we understand, that some would have loved to get a good deal too, we added a discount of 20% to the Season Pass. So if you didn't have the opportunity to buy the cheaper Ultimate Edition before, you can save money for the next two weeks as well. We think that's fair.

Furthermore, we are also obliged to provide a Season Pass to crowdfunding backers who paid for any possible DLC to come out. In this regard, we are simply fulfilling our promises we made long before Early Access.


[h1]F) Free2play is unfair![/h1]
The free2play version is not equal to the full version. The full version is still available to purchase and offers you more than the free version. See the info sheet below. Aside from that, everyone benefits from busy multiplayer lobbies and short waiting times for matches. If you want to know what the exact differences between the full version and free2play version are, please read this announcement.

http://steamcommunity.com/games/302670/announcements/detail/663547937787482857

[h1]G) You did not deliver what you promised![/h1]
No we did not. We delivered way more than we promised. Everything that has been promoted on the store page during Early Access is available to everyone who bought the game right now, even though the game is not even officially released yet. It took us longer to develop the game, because we wanted this game to be bigger and better with the help of the community. We are on the best way to achieve this and everyone will be able to enjoy more cool stuff that we will release for free next to paid content.


[h1]H) You didn't update the game for ages and now you want more money![/h1]
To our regret, this complaint comes from people who stopped playing the game altogether and didn't launch the game up for a long time. A review with a few hours in total and zero hours in the last 2 weeks or more, cannot be taken seriously and doesn't provide useful feedback to anyone. This is just venting some hate based on an ill informed opinion.

Contrary to that, we want to deliver a more enjoyable gaming experience to everyone! That is what indie development is about. If you are angry about shaddy business practices and excessive monetization, let big games corporations know, not passionate indie developers who try to provide the best possible game they can.

Check out the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/302670/discussions/0/541907675756457744/?ctp=3#c215439774871699976]Change-Log[/url] to find out what new stuff you got.


[h1]I) The game is P2W![/h1]
This point is really upsetting. We have yet to find out, why this game turned into pay to win by earning yourself some cosmetics. We guess, those who claim it is, have yet to find out themselves.


So here we are, don't fall for the haters, read our announcements and make up your mind after you collected all the facts. If you are still unhappy with the decision after reading all of this, please provide us feedback on how we can improve your experience with the game. In case, you still have questions, we happily answer them and clarify everything up as well. ːcta_emo1ː

notes.title: Open Beta
notes.notes:
[img]http://digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2banner_07.jpg[/img]
Welcome to the Open Beta of [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/302670]Call to Arms[/url]! Actually, we planned to have a soft launch to test everything out with a small group of players, but as it seems, this is already taking off without us doing anything, let alone announce it!


[h1]Major Update[/h1]

We just released the largest and most important update for Call to Arms to date. This massive patch includes tons of improvements, visually and performance wise, as well as plenty of new features to enhance your gameplay experience!

You can find the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/302670/discussions/0/541907675756457744/?ctp=3#c215439774871699976]Change-Log here[/url]!


[h1]Some Explanations[/h1]

Firstly, we would like to point out a few differences between the free2play edition and the Call to Arms full version. The free2play version is multiplayer only, does not give you access to Workshop, or LAN and requires you to unlock units via the progression system. Call to Arms full version on the other hand has a complete singleplayer and cooperative campaign available. Those who purchased the game earlier during Early Access paid 10$ less than what the game costs now. If you bought it during a sale, you paid even less. If you purchased the Deluxe Edition or backed the game on our website, then you’ll receive an additional singleplayer campaign and two minor factions for multiplayer, as soon as they are ready for release. Deluxe Edition owners also receive some exclusive in-game items.

Now there might be some of you who say, well, I don’t need all of that, I just bought that game for multiplayer. We understand that, but we also understand that multiplayer can only work if you have enough people to play with. Purchasing a game during Early Access is supporting the development of a game and we support our community by delivering you more and better content for free over a long period of time.

We would also like to point out, that even though the game is available for free to try out, it is still Early Access. That means the game is not complete and you play it at your own risk. If you do not understand or like the concept of Early Access, then please wait until the game is released. Every time we read a review that contains something like “But the game doesn’t look finished and uses stuff from MoW” a kitten dies. :cta_emo9:

To find out more, about the improvements that are in the latest update, check out the latest devupdate:
http://steamcommunity.com/games/302670/announcements/detail/646658987730392966


[h1]Season Pass[/h1]

Today we also launch the Season Pass for Call to Arms! If you are happy with the progress of the game and if you like to support the game even more, then you can purchase the Season Pass that contains 3 additional DLC, which will be available [b]after[/b] Early Access. With your help, we can create more factions and content at a faster speed. To reward your support, the Season Pass is 20% off for two weeks! Before you purchase, please check out the description on the store page.

[b]To clarify:[/b] everyone will get the new factions for free in multiplayer. Season Pass owners will get them earlier, while they are still in beta and don’t have to unlock any units. Furthermore, each DLC contains a new singleplayer campaign. Again, there will be no DLC available during Early Access, only Beta access to new factions. This is just another opportunity to support the game, while saving some bucks.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/561140


[h1]Steam Market[/h1]

Let’s talk about the biggest of all new features. The in-game market and items.

[b]How does it work?[/b]
Simply play the game with standard settings, singleplayer or multiplayer and you will receive some items here and there. These items are boxes that you can open to receive cool content.

[b]What items are there?[/b]
You can get some XP bonuses to unlock units faster if you play the free2play version. For those who own the full game already, you can save these items until new factions are available, trade them in the Steam market and earn some money, or exchange them into in-game cash. In-game cash can be exchanged into new boxes.

http://steamcommunity.com/market/search?appid=302670

As you can see, already plenty of people are trading in-game items and there are various levels of rarity. The rarer an item is, the more valuable it is.

[img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_78.jpg[/img]

There are also items, that allow you to customize your units. For instance, the squad logo badges and backgrounds. These items can be combined with colors you get and allow you to change the visual appearance of your profile and units. Simply click on your player avatar to customize your squad logo. This logo will be rendered on all your units in-game. If you want to preview it, you can do so by opening the Library.

We will add new items and cool stuff step by step in the future, but these items remain cosmetics or functional features and do not provide any advantages in pvp.

[img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_79.jpg[/img]

There is a lot more we want to talk about. But there is only so much space left on this page.

So stay tuned for more news and cool updates soon! :cta_emo7:

notes.title: Developers update 20
notes.notes:
[img]http://digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2banner_06.jpg[/img]
Welcome to our twentieth developers update for [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/302670]Call to Arms[/url]! We will use these updates to keep you posted on the progress of the development and features.

It’s been a massive ride lately, as our team has been pushing super hard to improve the game in every aspect!

[h1]Vehicles[/h1]
All vehicles have 4 times higher resolution textures now and feature squad logos on them, that you can customize easily by yourself. These logos are synced online, so that each player can be identified in the heat of combat!
Furthermore, we completely reworked the vehicle controls, they are much easier and smoother to use now. Vehicles have realistic acceleration and speed that depends on the terrain you are driving on and we just added vehicle suspension physics to the game! Not only that, but we also improved the vehicle interaction code with physics to finally stop the flipping over of vehicles. The interaction is not perfect yet, but it does the job and will be continuously improved.

Poor pathing has been adding lots of stress to players and we are pleased to say, that most issues have been solved and pathing has been improved dramatically. Still, it’s not perfect, but we will continue to work on this as well!

[url=http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_76b.jpg][img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_76.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]Graphics[/h1]
Graphics have been upgraded tremendously, as well as game performance. Your environment does look a lot better now and gives justice to the 3rd person controls. Expect many visual improvements in the future as well. For now, you will be able to enjoy HD textures and a much better overall visual presentation of the game!

[h1]Infantry Controls[/h1]
Some of you who tried out the open beta patch lately, probably noticed that we introduced 3rd person controls to infantry and we would like to share our plans for it. 3rd person controls will completely exchange all other control styles. As it stands, we develop two games, a RTS and a 3rd person shooter game. This is a lot of work and it is very difficult to accomplish. Adding a third old school control scheme from previous games just makes this task impossible and will heavily impact the overall quality of the game. Therefore, we will no longer work on it or support it. However, we made it easy for modders to enable the old control scheme if they desire.
Infantry controls will be a bit rough at the beginning, so please give us some time to polish them up. We are aware of the current issues and we are working on solutions for it. Just remember, how much the tank controls have been improved since the first iteration.

Our plans are to allow you to switch between squad members, as we believe the 3rd person feature should be mostly a squad based feature, not a primarily single soldier experience. In this regard, we will add specific UI controls to make it easy for you to keep track of your soldier and squad members. Furthermore, we are working on vastly improved infantry controls. You will be able to strafe, sprint and zoom on enemies depending on the weapon you carry with you. An easy way to switch between equipment is also planned. Many criticized the grenade tossing controls and we have plans to improve that as well.
At the end, we will deliver new animations to make the controls look and feel good. Further down the road, we will improve the camera behavior to allow better in door fighting.

Again, please give us some time to figure everything out. The controls are a step by step evolution.

Once infantry controls are done, you can expect new controls for helicopters to arrive!

[url=http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_77b.jpg][img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_77.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]Steam Market[/h1]
Call to Arms is now part of the Steam market and you can earn yourself some awesome in-game items. Some of them are the previously mentioned squad logos. To earn these items, you simply need to play the game and not leave running matches. Those who stay in-game until the match is over, will occasionally get rewarded by supply boxes. These supply boxes can be opened, as they contain various types of items. Got the same item twice? No problem, exchange it into in-game cash and trade it for new supply boxes, or go to the Steam market and sell your item to other players! Play and earn money. Sounds good, doesn’t it?

The late November update (no further delays), will be the biggest and most meaningful update the game has yet to receive and we are very happy how well the game has progressed lately. We hope, you will be as well! :cta_emo10:

notes.title: Developers update 19
notes.notes:
[img]http://digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2banner_05.jpg[/img]

Welcome to our nineteenth developers update for [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/302670]Call to Arms[/url]! We will use these updates to keep you posted on the progress of the development and features.

The development of Call to Arms is in full swing and we have many news to share!


In the next update, we will include the long awaited library. You can look up all the stats of every weapon, soldier and vehicle in the main menu and study them carefully before entering the heat of combat!

[url=http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_74b.jpg][img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_74b.jpg[/img][/url]

We are also upgrading all vehicles to 4k resoluted textures, which is 4 times more detailed than the current ones. Furthermore, we will re-do the infantry skins to fit our latest quality standards. Call to Arms will go through continued evolution and we will continuously make the game look and play better!

In this regard, we also announce the Season Pass coming for Call to Arms. [b](important: [u]no[/u] DLC will be available during Early Access!)[/b] It will include the Minor Factions pack (this one is also included in Deluxe Edition and available to backers), as well as the German and Russian armies. Furthermore you will get access to two new singleplayer and cooperative campaigns upon completion!

[h1]Season Pass[/h1]
[list][*]Season Pass owners will get Early Access to new factions
[*]Everyone will receive access to the new factions upon full completion of each DLC
[*]If you do not own the DLC or Season Pass, you will have to unlock the units via level progression and you will not receive the singleplayer/cooperative campaigns
[*]The Season Pass will possibly include more DLC if the game is successful, Season Pass owners will get them lifelong for free
[/list]


[h1]Monetization[/h1]
We announced that Call to Arms will have a free2play version. Let's clarify how we intend to monetize the game:
[list][*]Free2play version will not have mods, no singleplayer and will have unit progression enabled
[*]If you buy the game or corresponding faction DLC, you will not have to unlock any units and therefore save time
[*]There will be [u]no[/u] pay2win elements in Call to Arms
[*]We will add Steam Market items to the game, they will be cosmetic or have convenient features included[/list]


[url=http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_75b.jpg][img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_75b.jpg[/img][/url]

Such items will be squad logos, which you can customize and place on all of your units to distinguish them from other players. XP boosts and smilies for the chat will be included too, as well as other neat features! You will earn these items by simply playing the game or trading them in the market.


You can check out the open beta on Steam! :cta_emo7:

[list][*]Free2play version will not have mods, no singleplayer and will have unit progression enabled
[*]If you buy the game or corresponding faction DLC, you will not have to unlock any units and therefore save time
[*]There will be [u]no[/u] pay2win elements in Call to Arms
[*]We will add Steam Market items to the game, they will be cosmetic or have convenient features included[/list]


[url=http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_75b.jpg][img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_75b.jpg[/img][/url]

Such items will be squad logos, which you can customize and place on all of your units to distinguish them from other players. XP boosts and smilies for the chat will be included too, as well as other neat features! You will earn these items by simply playing the game or trading them in the market.


You can check out the open beta on Steam! ːcta_emo7ː

notes.title: Developers update 18
notes.notes:
[img]http://digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2banner_04.jpg[/img]

Welcome to our eighteenth developers update for [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/302670]Call to Arms[/url]! We will use these updates to keep you posted on the progress of the development and features.

Today we are going to announce some exciting changes and plans we have for Call to Arms!

Firstly, we are sticking to our plans to "finish" up the game in October this year. However, we will not move out of Early Access at this stage. What we will do instead, is to polish up the game and release the content we have promised before. This means you will receive the full US campaign, 20 multiplayer maps and two factions with dozens of units and various gamemodes. Furthermore, we will launch a free2play edition of Call to Arms in October that includes the basic multiplayer, but with unit progression and no access to singleplayer or mods. This way, new players can try the game out before purchasing and they will be able to play with people who own the full game as well.

As announced before, we are also working on some Eastern European environment setting and we will expand the game by two minor factions that will be part of the GRM campaign DLC. (This DLC will be included in the Deluxe Edition for free). It will be available a few months after the October free2play release and is one of our measures to increase the longevity of the game.

Our full release is targeted at Q1 2017 with complete voice overs, localizations and new features and fixes. We think we need the extra time to give the game justice and to collect enough feedback from users. But again, we do this mostly to make this game bigger and better than we initially promised. Some new features that are coming soon are:


[h1]Weapon library[/h1]
You will be able to check out all weapons and vehicles, as well as soldiers in the main menu with corresponding stats. This will help you to learn the game and to understands the pros and cons of your equipment. It's also a very nice way to check out on the details each weapon has.

[h1]Market[/h1]
We will include a Steam item market into the game. This way you will be able to collect some free items (for instance in-game chat smilies) by playing the game and some of you might even earn some cash by trading these items in the Steam market. Expect more details to be available soon!

[h1]Choppers[/h1]
Yes, they will be coming in October too. Hopefully we can show them off soon!


[url=http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_73b.jpg][img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_73.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: Developers update 17
notes.notes:
[img]http://digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2banner_02.jpg[/img]

Welcome to our seventeenth developers update for [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/302670]Call to Arms[/url]! We will use these updates to keep you posted on the progress of the development and features.

We at Digitalmindsoft are celebrating our 10th Anniversary this month!

In the last 10 years many things have changed and we are very grateful for the opportunity to work on a game like Call to Arms. Since the start of Early Access, our on-site Team has doubled in size and we will be moving to a new office early next year to continue our growth strategy. We have been collecting a lot of experience and gathered tons of feedback from our community and the game is getting bigger and better every day. All of this would not have been possible without your help, so thank you!


[h1]In this regard, we also have some amazing things to announce![/h1]

We are currently working on some Eastern European environment setting and we will expand the game by two minor factions that will be part of the GRM campaign DLC. (This DLC will be included in the Deluxe Edition for free) One of the two factions are the Arab government forces that fight against the GRM in the campaign. We are also working on an Eastern European rebellion force that will be a nice fit for to the new scenery. Both factions will make heavy use of the already existing weapons, but each of them comes with unique equipment not available to others.

They will also support the newly introduced alliance feature. The Arab government forces will team up with the US troops, while the Eastern Europeans will join the GRM in multiplayer games.

Furthermore, our artists started to polish the game up and lots of assets have been improved in the last couple of months. Old vehicles will get up to 4 times higher resolution, so that they are rendered with beautiful details even when playing in 3rd person mode. Lots of engine improvements and bug fixes have been done as well. Furthermore, our programmers are working on new features such as helicopters and an in-menu weapons library.

Plenty of new assets and new maps will be available in the 10th anniversary update coming to you next month. Exciting times lay ahead!

Call to Arms is still progressing very well and we added a good amount of content lately!
