notes.title: Developers update 15
notes.notes:
[img]http://digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2banner_03.jpg[/img]

Welcome to our fifteenth developers update for [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/302670]Call to Arms[/url]! We will use these updates to keep you posted on the progress of the development and features.

Call to Arms is progressing very well and we have quite some news for you!

[h1]Alliances[/h1]
One of the biggest new features will be the upcoming multiplayer alliances. In the future, you will be able to play with different factions in the same team. Hosts have the option between:
[list][*]the classic mode of faction vs. faction
[*]alliances that represent factions that fight together in the story-line
[*]free factions in which each player can choose whatever he wants to play with
[/list]

This might not be ground breaking at this point, but it’s an important feature for the future of Call to Arms. After the release of the game, we will be working on new factions that can partner up with the existing ones!

[h1]King of the Hill[/h1]
Thanks to the new code for the alliances feature, you will also be able to play games with more than 2 teams. For instance king of the hill 2v2v2v2. More cool gamemodes will be coming soon to add a nice variation to the game!

[h1]Thermal vision[/h1]
To enhance usability of 3rd person in dense environments, we’ve been working on thermal vision for vehicles. It will make it much easier for you to spot enemies and focus on what’s really important during combat.

[h1]Release date[/h1]
We are scheduling the game for a release in October 2016. Thanks to your support we are able to make this game bigger and better, hence we want to use the time to really polish the game up for a great experience.

Call to Arms has been coming along nicely and we will continue to push the game forward! :cta_emo10:

notes.title: Developers update 14
notes.notes:
[img]http://digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2banner_09.jpg[/img]

Welcome to our fourteenth developers update for [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/302670]Call to Arms[/url]! We will use these updates to keep you posted on the progress of the development and features.

It’s been a while since our last patch for Call to Arms and we are happy to tell you the waiting was worth it!

[h1]Medics[/h1]
We finally added the medic unit class! Unlike in previous games, the medic is a specifically trained soldier with a unique ability to revive wounded soldiers. Furthermore, we added a mechanic that only veteran soldiers can be revived. So it takes a little bit of an extra effort to get your soldiers on to the “safe side”. Reviving isn’t instant either, but it takes a couple of seconds depending on how qualified your medic is. After that, your medic and your revived soldier will auto prone to hide from enemy fire. For the first time ever, your medic will also work in competitive multiplayer and you can revive friendly units as well!

[h1]Sounds[/h1]
We’ve been reworking the whole sound environment with a huge amount of high quality stereo sounds and we will continue to polish the sound effects until we are fully satisfied! This time you will enjoy new and realistic reloading sounds, amazing silencer sounds and a huge variety of extremely well recorded environment sounds and much more!

[h1]Weapon damage[/h1]
We introduced a completely new system for weapon damage to reflect real world fire arms even better in the game. Thanks to the idea of our community member Blub0r2k, we are now using a system that uses muzzle velocity and gun calibre size to determine the strength of a weapon.

[h1]Balance[/h1]
The game has become too hardcore and too frustrating at times, hence we have re-balanced the whole small arms fire damage. The damage curve is a lot more straight forward now and the weapon damage is much better balanced to reward taking risk and flanking units, as well as making defending easier against hordes of enemy soldiers. Last Man Standing and Evacuation have been rebalanced as well. A new growing CP system has been introduced to make early game less spammy but more tactical and versatile.

[h1]Ammo trucks[/h1]
New units joined the battlefield as well! Finally both the US and the GRM have basic trucks and ammo trucks in their unit roster to re-supply or to transport units quickly!

[h1]Enhanced 3rd person interface[/h1]
We added an improved 3rd person interface that shows you your tank orientation and damaged parts. A compass helps you to communicate and mark enemy units for your teammates. A crew display helps you to understand the effects of losing crew members to enemy fire and a new weapon selection system allows you to quickly switch weapons by just pressing the designated number!

[h1]Main menu interface[/h1]
Of course our biggest project, the new main menu interface is progressing as well! LAN mode is re-enabled for local games and single skirmish matches. We’ve also been working on many improvements and bug fixes. Very important for anyone looking to level up: the XP display has been re-added to the session screen. Furthermore we have been working on the party system. Once completed, you will be able to invite your friends to chat in private and to join/host games together.

[h1]Engine improvements[/h1]
We are currently reworking effects like Ambient Occlusion and Sun Rays to enhance performance and graphics fidelity. This also includes new weather effects, like day and night cycle, as well as fancy new effects.



[url=http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_65b.jpg][img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_65.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_66b.jpg][img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_66.jpg[/img][/url]

As you see, we have been doing many improvements to the game lately and we will continue to push the pace at which these improvements are done. Expect more cool stuff soon!

The patch will be available later this weekend. ːcta_emo1ː

notes.title: Developers update 13
notes.notes:
[img]http://digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2banner_05.jpg[/img]

Welcome to our thirteenth developers update for [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/302670]Call to Arms[/url]! We will use these updates to keep you posted on the progress of the development and features.

[h1]Beta[/h1]
Call to Arms will soon move to Beta status, this means that we are half-way through the Early Access phase and all owners of the standard edition will receive the first 5 singleplayer missions to play. It also means, that once we are in beta, we will increase the price of the game by 5$. Hence if you plan to get the game you shouldn't wait for too long!

Soon after the Beta has been launched, we will update the Roadmap, as we decided to take some additional time to listen and to implement player feedback in the game. Overall, the game has changed a lot from the early days after launch and we are excited to work on new and cool features to enhance the game even more!

Let's talk about what we have done since the last developers update.


[h1]New tracer behaviour and bullet physics[/h1]
Bullets can now bounce off from a lot more materials than before, this also includes ground surfaces. In the next update, tracers will also behave realistically. Instead of appearing randomly, they will follow a realistic ammo belt pattern. Furthermore, tracers are disabled for most weapons like in real life. However, if you use direct control, tracers are enabled for your weapon and you can mark enemy units for your allies!

[h1]Armored Warfare[/h1]
We also added a new gamemode, specifically designed for vehicle combat. We improved ATGM controls as they play a very important role in that gamemode. APCs can now capture strategic points and in the next update they will be able supply other vehicles with ammunition. To make re-supplying easier, supply trucks are planned to follow next. To enhance your chances to survive in tank combat, we added smoke launchers to tanks. These can be activated by simply pressing "mouse button 3".

[h1]Gun behaviour[/h1]
In 3rd person, gun ranges are unlimited and penetration physics represent this very well now. We also changed muzzle speeds of tank guns and small arms to enhance realism. To make things even more interesting, we added support for different ammo behaviour even though they use the same gun. This wasn't possible before, but now you have different muzzle speeds and shell behaviours depending on what kind of ammo you load and fire. For instance, T80-U's can now shoot ATGMs through their main gun.

[h1]Flashbangs[/h1]
Flashbang stunning effect has been added too! The closer somebody is to a flashbang explosion the longer he will get stunned. During that time infantry is unable to perform actions, this is very handy if you want to advance into heavily guarded areas.

[h1]New interface[/h1]
Of course, we also released the new main menu interface. It's still work in progress and many features like offline skirmishes vs. bots, LAN games and Match-Making will be added step by step. Since we have to completely rework the interface code, it takes a while to finish each task, but we are moving forward steadily. Additionally, we are starting to improve the in-game GUI step by step, as well as the 3rd person interface.

[h1]Sounds[/h1]
New high quality vehicles sounds have been added lately and as a next step we will introduce the in-game music. Completely new voice acting is planned too, but it will be done closer to release, as the game needs to be feature ready for any kind of localization work.

Of course, we have been adding a lot more thing as well, if you want to know the details, please check the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/302670/discussions/0/541907675756457744/#c458606248625270537]Change-Log[/url].


[img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_59.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Developers update 11
notes.notes:
[img]http://digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2banner_05.jpg[/img]

Welcome to our eleventh developers update for [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/302670]Call to Arms[/url]! We will use these updates to keep you posted on the progress of the development and features.


[h1]Civilians[/h1]
As you can see below, we added new humanskins for civilians, they will play a minor role in the campaign. So be careful what you are aiming for!

[url=http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_43b.jpg][img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_43.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]New buildings[/h1]
Our artists are working on a variety of new buildings for different settings. Expect huge hotels and office buildings as well as slum huts. Each map and mission will have its own unique and distinct feeling attached to it.

[url=http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_44b.jpg][img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_44.jpg[/img][/url]


[h1]New units[/h1]
We were working on new units such as the Humvee with a TOW and a technical using a ZPU AA-gun. They add faction variety and help us to balance gameplay between factions. Our next move will be to start working on faction specific trucks for transport and re-supplying.

[url=http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_45b.jpg][img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_45.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_46b.jpg][img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_46.jpg[/img][/url]


[h1]New main menu interface[/h1]
Finally, we began to work on the new main menu interface. It is a huge task as we will design it from the ground up. This means that updates may not come in as frequent as before, at least until the interface is fully functional. We will show you some work in progress screenshots soon, so stay tuned!

See you on the battlefield! ːcta_emo1ː

notes.title: Developers update 9
notes.notes:
[img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2banner_10.jpg[/img]
Welcome to our ninth developers update for [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/302670]Call to Arms[/url]! We will use these updates to keep you posted on the progress of the development and features.

Check out the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/302670/discussions/0/541907675756457744/#c523898291501172400]Change-Log[/url] of the latest patch!


[h1]New multiplayer map[/h1]
The community voted for a new multiplayer map: 4v4 Military base. This map is expanding the existing pool by a unique setting and different gameplay. We are definitely excited to see it in the next patch!

[h1]New gamemode[/h1]
We are currently working on a new multiplayer gamemode called King of the Hill. It’s a 1v1v1v1 battle with a single center flag. Everyone is up against each other and only the best player can win in this mode. You will have to develop unique strategies to overcome your enemies and you have to time your actions carefully as you will not receive any payback for lost troops.

[h1]Small arms & improvements[/h1]
We have been adding a few new small arms to the game, including proper tank machine guns for GRM. We have also added shields to technicals to provide some protection to frontal fire, however they still offer weak protection if they are getting flanked. Additionally we added much better LODing for trees. It will allow us to render vegetation on long distance without hurting performance too much.

[h1]New water[/h1]
Aside from Screen Space Ambient Occlusion we are also working on new water technology! Water will blend in softly and take depth into consideration. It will also simulate the distortion of objects below the water surface. It will be quite a step visually and new water plants will add extra diversity to maritime landscapes, even a shark will pass by once in a while!

[img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_42.jpg[/img]

The community voted for the M2A3 Bradley and BMP-2 and today they joined the battlefield in Call to Arms! Both are equipped with deadly weaponry. For the first time you are able to use TOWs that add a new level of depth to tank combat.

[h1]New gamemode[/h1]
We have been working on a new gamemode for Call to Arms which is called Last Man Standing. Contrary to Domination, you do not receive any payback for lost units during the battle. This makes the gamemode a lot more tactical and strategic as keeping your men alive is your key priority. To regain some resources, you can capture supply boxes on the map. These supply boxes provide great incentive to push into enemy territory. You win the match if you reach the score limit by destroying enemy troops, or if your enemy runs out of troops, or if you capture their base flag.

[h1]New graphic options[/h1]
Finally we introduced a simple way to select your graphic options with presets ranging from minimal to ultra. These settings are optimized and heavily recommended. Furthermore, we re-introduced the no shadow option.

[h1]Multiplayer optimization[/h1]
We polished the level of detail settings and introduced special settings for multiplayer. This allow us to enhance the graphics fidelity in singleplayer without hurting the performance in multiplayer!

notes.title: Developers update 7
notes.notes:
[img]http://digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2banner_06.jpg[/img]

Welcome to our seventh developers update for [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/302670]Call to Arms[/url]! We will use these updates to keep you posted on the progress of the development and features.


[h1]New vehicles[/h1]
APCs are joining the battle in Call to Arms! Their special ability is to re-supply friendly units nearby, if necessary they will also provide the required fire power to support advancing infantry. The update is already live, so check out the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/302670/discussions/0/541907675756457744/#c527273452875779614]change-log![/url]

[h1]3rd person controls[/h1]
We also improved 3rd person controls, now it's as simple as pressing your middle mouse button and the AI will take over the gunner position and do the shooting while you focus on driving!

[h1]Soft particles[/h1]
Usually particles clip with surrounding objects. They look flat and unatural. Soft particles on the other side use scene depth information to render particles accurately by taking surrounding objects into consideration. The result are much better for effects of any kind!

[h1]Glow with HDR[/h1]
We also added glow with HDR support to the engine. They are used to highlight light materials such as lamps, fire, explosions and so on. If applied to existing effects, you will see much better results. Just compare the first screenshot (no soft particles, no glow with HDR) with the second screenshot!


[url=http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_39b.jpg][img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_39.jpg[/img][/url]


[h1]Night vision[/h1]
We added night vision environments for intense night combat experiences. The game does not only turn green, but light sources are much stronger including weapon tracers. You can enjoy it in the video below.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CK3QX4TAAuM&feature=youtu.be

notes.title: Developers update 6
notes.notes:
[img]http://digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2banner_04.jpg[/img]

Welcome to our sixth developers update for [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/302670]Call to Arms[/url]! We will use these updates to keep you posted on the progress of the development and features.


[h1]Depth of field[/h1]
The game engine supports depth of field now. It's a great feature to enhance the visuals of cutscenes and long distance views. From now on, the engine is able to collect scene depth information and that allows us to work on new features such as soft particles, ambient occlusion and much better water. So expect many cool visual upgrades soon!

[h1]Unicode[/h1]
Finally, we added Unicode support to the engine! That means all non-latin chat symbols and nicknames will be displayed correctly. If you are a modder, make sure your localization files are all converted to UTF-8 without BOM.


[url=http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_33b.jpg][img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_33.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_34b.jpg][img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_34.jpg[/img][/url]


[h1]Squad leaders[/h1]
We have added new skins for infantry squad leaders. Now they differ from the regular soldiers and you can easily distinguish them from other squad members. Our next step will be to deliver different regular soldier faces to enhance visual variety on the battlefield.

[url=http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_35b.jpg][img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_35.jpg[/img][/url]


[h1]Chatwheel[/h1]
We added a chatwheel for notifications (hold “n”) and for chat messages (hold “z” or “shift + z”)
These messages allow you to quickly communicate with your team members and mark important locations or units. It helps to break language barriers and in the final version of Call to Arms, the chatwheel text notifications will also be automatically translated in the language of the receiver.

[img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_36.jpg[/img]


Please check the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/302670/discussions/0/541907675756457744/#c537405286641576925]Change-Log[/url] of the latest update! ːcta_emo1ː

notes.title: Release date announced!
notes.notes:
[img]http://digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2banner_09.jpg[/img]

Today we are announcing the release schedule for [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/302670]Call to Arms[/url]!

The game will hit Steam Early Access on the [b]30th of July[/b] with a price tag of [b]USD 19.99[/b] for the standard edition and [b]USD 29.99[/b] for the Deluxe Edition.

The Early Access version contains the full infantry unit roster, as well as a few multiplayer maps, multiplayer bots, replays, Steam Workshop and the map/mission editor. Owners of the Deluxe Edition also get to try out the first missions of the upcoming work in progress singleplayer campaign. After the development of the singleplayer missions has been finished, all owners of the Early Access version receive them for free.

After the launch of the game we will gradually release more content, including multiplayer maps, gamemodes, as well as vehicles step by step.
We estimate the game to be in Early Access until Q1 2016.


We have done a lot of improvements lately and we added human skin variations and support for camouflage depending on the season of the map you are playing on. Many new weapons have been added as well and a lot of gameplay improvements have been introduced.

The game will hit Steam Early Access on the [b]30th of July[/b] with a price tag of [b]USD 19.99[/b] for the standard edition and [b]USD 29.99[/b] for the Deluxe Edition.

The Early Access version contains the full infantry unit roster, as well as a few multiplayer maps, multiplayer bots, replays, Steam Workshop and the map/mission editor. Owners of the Deluxe Edition also get to try out the first missions of the upcoming work in progress singleplayer campaign. After the development of the singleplayer missions has been finished, all owners of the Early Access version receive them for free.

After the launch of the game we will gradually release more content, including multiplayer maps, gamemodes, as well as vehicles step by step.
We estimate the game to be in Early Access until Q1 2016.


We have done a lot of improvements lately and we added human skin variations and support for camouflage depending on the season of the map you are playing on. Many new weapons have been added as well and a lot of gameplay improvements have been introduced.


Check out the new screenshots!

notes.notes:
[img]http://digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2banner_07.jpg[/img]

Welcome to our fourth developers update for [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/302670]Call to Arms[/url]! We will use these updates to keep you posted on the progress of the development and features.


[h1]Upcoming Release[/h1]
So we are finally ready to provide some details about the upcoming release of the game. Currently we are planning send out keys to backers within the next 2 weeks. The game will hit Early Access by the end of July or August. The final dates will be announced once we collected the first feedback from our backers. As much as we want you guys to start playing the game, we want to make sure your experience is as good as it can be.

The game will be available in a standard version and a Deluxe Edition. We are excited to announce that we will allow you to try out the work in progress missions if you own the Deluxe Edition. Once the missions are finalized, they will be available to everyone who purchased the game. The game comes with multiplayer bots to enjoy the game at the pace you choose. We will start off with infantry combat and we will introduce vehicles step by step to multiplayer. On top of it, you will receive the map/mission editor out of the box together with Steam Workshop support.


[url=http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_21b.jpg][img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_21.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_22b.jpg][img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_22.jpg[/img][/url]


[h1]Domination Gamemode[/h1]
We are currently working on an objective based gamemode. Each team has to capture strategic positions placed on the map, the amount depends on the player count. The team with more flags receives scores. The team that reaches the score limit first wins. The strategic points provide cover to your troops and most importantly they will allow you to re-supply. This adds another element to the game, as you can destroy the ammo caches with Composite C-4 or mine them with Claymores if you want to prevent enemies from taking advantage of it. ːhonorː

notes.notes:
[img]http://digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2banner_06.jpg[/img]

Welcome to our third developers update for [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/302670]Call to Arms[/url]! We will use these updates to keep you posted on the progress of the development and features.


[h1]New Shaders & Fortifications[/h1]
We are stepping up the visuals with new shader technology for Call to Arms. One of these shaders is called light scattering to simulate a beautiful sunrise. A grain filter has been added as well, it allows us to work on night vision effects for the future. Moreover we are working on plenty of new assets, for instance new base fortifications including fortified guard towers.

[h1]Improved Foliage Rendering[/h1]
We have done plenty of improvements to the way foliage is being rendered. It's more effecient and much more effective than before. Now the landscape feels and looks better and the environment matters even more!

notes.title: Developers update 1
notes.notes:
[img]http://digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2banner_04.jpg[/img]

Welcome to our first developers update for [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/302670]Call to Arms[/url]! We will use these updates to keep you posted on the progress of the development and features.


[h1]Dynamic Shellholes[/h1]
The game features dynamic shellholes that depend on the strength of the explosion and the ground below. To create an outstanding volumetric effect we added displacement maps to smaller shellholes. This parallax effect delivers an amazing result and immersion. In case of bigger explosions, the terrain will be deformed and new three-dimensional cover will be created.

[url=http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_07b.jpg][img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_07.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_08b.jpg][img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_08.jpg[/img][/url]


[h1]Instanced grass[/h1]
We have been reworking the previous grass rendering system completely. The new instanced grass supports high resolution textures, as well as normal maps and speculars. New types of grass can be easily created and thanks to new random placement modifiers, it will look a lot more natural than before. Of course, modders can easily take advantage of this system and add new grass types of their liking. We are certainly excited to discover the creativeness of our community!

[url=http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_09b.jpg][img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_09.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: Update on the game!
notes.notes:
[img]http://digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2banner_03.jpg[/img]

Finally, it is time to start with regular updates on the progress of the development of [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/302670]Call to Arms[/url]! We are confident the waiting was worth it and our new screenshots certainly confirm this.


[url=http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_03b.jpg][img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_03.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_04b.jpg][img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_04.jpg[/img][/url]


[h1]What can you expect?[/h1]
The Early Access version will include multiplayer bots and replays, as well as full Steamworks integration. You will be able to play against AI or other players on a few multiplayer maps. Each of these maps has a very distinct environment and we will gradually improve and polish them as we collect feedback from players. We think quality comes before quantity, therefore we want to ensure each map plays as well as it possibly could. On top of it, we will provide you all the tools to create and upload your own maps to Steam Workshop!

[url=http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_05b.jpg][img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_05.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_06b.jpg][img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_06.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]Release schedule[/h1]
We plan to release the game to backers within the next 3 months. Depending on how well the early Alpha is received, we will go live with the Early Access version a few weeks later. At this point, the game will lack a lot of features and content, but it will be stable to play. In any case, we have a clear roadmap for the game and we will deliver you a polished and finished product in the end. To avoid making any false promises, we only share details of the game that will make it into the game for certain. We think, Early Access is a lot about trust and we take this very seriously.

Our plans for the full version is Q1 2016. Until then, you will frequently receive updates and new content along the way!


Join our facebook page for small updates on the game:
https://www.facebook.com/CallToArmsGame

notes.title: Welcome!
notes.notes:
[img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2banner_01.jpg[/img]

Welcome to [b]Call to Arms[/b] on Steam!

Many of you have been backing [url=http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/products/call-to-arms]Call to Arms[/url] already and we think it's time to start sharing our plans for the near future.


Digitalmindsoft is an official Steam partner and we will self-publish the game on Steam. This way we are not only independent as a company, but we also maintain full control over the game. Which ultimately translates into a higher return of investment and therefore into a better game with more features and content for you to enjoy! ːhonorː

It will take a while until we share detailed information about the game and features, as our main focus right now is to improve [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/244450]Men of War: Assault Squad 2[/url]. None the less it's time to step out of the dark and to hand out at least some news for you to anticipate.


As mentioned, we will directly go to Steam, therefore we will scrap our plans to move the game to kickstarter. This also means that we won't excessively promote the backing possibilty on our own website. However, if you want to take advantage of the cool backing options, better do it sooner than later, as we won't keep the website up for too long anymore. (We will notify you before closing it down.)


Our plans are to give our backers access to the game later this year. If everything works as supposed to we will add the game to Steam Early Access so everyone who buys the game on Steam can play it instantly.


In September we will start posting regular news in order to keep you updated on the development process. For now, I have 2 screenshots for you!

[url=http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_01b.jpg][img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_01.jpg[/img][/url]


[url=http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_02b.jpg][img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/2update_02.jpg[/img][/url]


You can get more information on our Facebook page:
https://www.facebook.com/CallToArmsGame

Enjoy!
